notes:
Refers to organizing items into groups or categories based on shared characteristics. Used in academic, scientific, and everyday contexts such as sorting garbage, organizing files, or classifying species.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{分類|ぶんるい}→分類：04790_bunrui⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧: classification criteria
- ⟦{分類|ぶんるい}→分類：04790_bunrui⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: classification method
- ⟦{分類|ぶんるい}→分類：04790_bunrui⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: classification number
- ⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧{分類|ぶんるい}する: to classify in detail
- ⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{分類|ぶんるい}する: to classify broadly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仕分|しわ}ける→仕分ける：20080_shiwakeru⟧: to sort; to separate — more hands-on, physical sorting of items into groups
- ⟦{区分|くぶん}→区分：00248_kubun⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to divide; to section — focuses on drawing boundaries between categories
- ⟦{整理|せいり}する→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧: to organize; to tidy up — broader term that includes putting things in order, not necessarily into categories
